'''Medore Damara''' is a [[Tairen]] noblewoman who is one of the daughters of [[High Lord]] [[Astoril Damara]].{{ref/book|c|Medore Damara}} 

== Appearance ==
She is tall with bright blue eyes and a dark face. She is close to beautiful. Her large bosom makes the puffy-sleeved Tairen coats look odd on her.

Her favorite mare is Redwing.

== History ==
Medore is the only daughter of High Lord Astoril Damara and his second wife, and was born in {{ne|981}}. She has two full brothers, and two elder half-sisters from her father's first marriage, the elder of whom is now High Lady and High Seat of House Damara. Her father had two sons from his first marriage, one of whom died in the [[Aiel War]], and another of whom died of sickness.{{ref/book|c|Astoril Damara}}

== Activities ==
[[Estean Andiama]] planned to marry her or her sister, saying he wpuld flip a coin or choose Medore, as she "has two or three pretty maids."{{ref/book|4|2}}

A member of [[Cha Faile]]. She accompanied [[Faile Bashere]] to [[Ghealdan]]. When Faile was captured by the [[Shaido]], she was forced to obey [[Perrin Aybara]].

She accompanies [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Sebban Balwer]], who took ''Cha Faile'' under his wing, into [[So Habor]]. They found [[Martyn Tallanvor]] there and brought him back to Perrin. 

Balwer had set Medore up to spy on [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron|Berelain]] and [[Annoura Larisen|Annoura]] due to her high rank, but Perrin put a stop to that.

When Perrin and [[Tylee Khirgan]]'s group went to [[Almizar]], Medore and Balwer slipped away to collect information.
